text_simplified: The author recommends caring for the daughter's prayer and making her feel its great importance. Encouragement in the early stages can include placing candy on the prayer mat or buying her a prayer mat. She should also be tasked with following the prayer times so her heart becomes attached to prayer. He also quotes Ibn Taymiyyah on the punishment for whoever does not command the young child to pray. Individual abilities should be considered, directing the strength of memorization toward the Quran instead of what does not benefit. He mentions that those who joined Quran memorization schools became serious and disciplined in their lives.
